primitives.name: Intake Constraint Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Intake Require: - deck purpose - audience - source content - desired slide count - exact claims/data - requested aspect ratio - existing PPTX template, if any Do not invent mission, values, market statistics, pricing, claims, contacts, or product variants to fill slides.
primitives.assumptions: All inputs are deterministic and fully specified; no synthetic data generation occurs.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When any required parameter is unspecified or ambiguous.

layer2.mapping: Maps intake parameters to a constrained configuration space in GSI's probabilistic model of slide content validity.
layer2.telemetry: Verification of completeness and correctness of intake metadata.

primitives.name: Template Construction Kernel
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Build - Existing PPTX → edit its masters/layouts or unpack/repack OOXML locally.
primitives.assumptions: Template exists and is compatible with local tooling.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When no template is provided or incompatible with toolchain.

layer2.mapping: Generates layout families from existing templates via OOXML manipulation in GSE's rendering engine.
layer2.telemetry: Successful application of master layouts and shape preservation.

primitives.name: Quality Assurance Validator
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## QA and approval Render slides for inspection with headless LibreOffice (`soffice --headless --convert-to pdf`, then `pdftoppm`), fix, and re-render.
primitives.assumptions: Rendering tools are available and functional.
primitives.breakdown_regime: On rendering failures or validation errors.

layer2.mapping: Maps QA checks to a binary pass/fail condition in GSI's verification framework.
layer2.telemetry: Pass/fail status of rendered slide quality metrics.
